subject: Service Disruption — CloudCore Compute
body:
Status: RESOLVED

Incident start: 2027-03-03 10:05 UTC
Incident end: 2027-03-03 13:15 UTC
Duration: 190 minutes
Affected services: CloudCore Compute (us-west-2 region)
Impact: Customers hosted in us-west-2 experienced complete unavailability of compute services.
Root cause: Network switch failure in the us-west-2a availability zone caused a cascading failure across the compute cluster.
Resolution: Failover to backup switches and cluster restart.

No Scheduled Maintenance was in effect during this incident.

subject: Service Disruption — March 3 Incident
body:
Dear Nora,

I'm writing to inform you of a service disruption that affected the Route Optimizer platform on March 3, 2027. Our hosting provider experienced an infrastructure failure that caused the platform to be unavailable from approximately 10:05 UTC to 13:15 UTC (approximately 190 minutes).

No Scheduled Maintenance was occurring at the time of the incident. We are reviewing the root cause with our infrastructure provider and will provide a full incident report within the timeframe specified in our agreement.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption and are taking steps to improve our failover capabilities.

Best regards,
Raj Subramanian
Head of Customer Success, Quillhub Inc.

subject: M4 delivery update
body:
Phone call summary (logged by Dana Kowalski):

Elena called to let me know that the M4 (Integration and Testing) deliverable will be about a week late. She said the API integration is taking longer than expected because of some undocumented endpoints in our backend. She's targeting delivery by March 7, 2027 instead of the original February 28, 2027 due date.

I told her we understand and to keep us posted. No formal extension has been agreed to in writing.

Note: This is a phone call log, not a formal notice.
